title: Chapter 160 Secondary Village
content:
Chapter 160 Secondary Village

Wang Shuo, who did not give up, stood there like a wooden stake, slowly studying the exchanged items.

After a while, his eyes lit up.

He spent 100,000 energy crystals to exchange for a barracks.

[Basic barracks: can convert the territory's people into militia, and can be upgraded to other arms barracks. ]

It is much more expensive than the price Zhao Bangde offered before.

But now, there is only this way, and he has no choice.

If he doesn't exchange it today, if it's gone tomorrow, he will only cry!

What Wang Shuo didn't know was that some of the items inside were fixed for a long time, while a small part would change every day, and even every time it was refreshed.

The barracks still looked like a model that was reduced countless times.

Wang Shuo found the village construction map, looked at the location of the barracks, walked to the corresponding location, and placed the barracks in his hand.

For this kind of props provided by the system, there is no need to build, it is a finished product directly.

In an instant, a military camp covering an area of thousands of square meters appeared in front of him, which was much larger than the lord's mansion.

Many people in the territory saw the scene in front of them and ran over excitedly to watch the excitement.

Wang Shuo also walked in first.

I saw a huge parade ground appeared inside the gate.

It seemed a bit empty inside.

There was a row of buildings in front of him, with several rooms.

Wang Shuo walked into the middle one.

I saw something similar to the core of the territory appear in front of me.

Wang Shuo walked in and saw that the system prompt sounded:

[The types of barracks that can be upgraded are: 1 archer barracks, 2 shield barracks, 3 cavalry barracks, 4 spear barracks... A second-level village is required, and 10,000 energy crystals are required. ]

Wang Shuo showed a hint of joy in his eyes.

The current population of the territory has reached 260 people, and the tool people are also counted as the population of the territory.

The conditions for upgrading the level 2 village have been met.

Wang Shuo hurried back to the lord's mansion, came to the core of the territory, and upgraded the level 2 village.

[Do you want to upgrade Wana Village to a second-level village? 】

"Yes."

Not long after, I heard the system prompt.

[Upgrade successful. ]

Nothing seemed to have changed!

Wang Shuo was wondering why there was no time limit for this upgrade. Was it because the system did not automatically build buildings?

Wang Shuo carefully felt it and carefully checked the territory attribute panel.

[Territory attributes]

[Territory: Wana Village (secondary village)]

[Lord: Wang Shuo]

[Territory attributes: popular support, outstanding people and beautiful scenery]

[Territory reputation: 100 (newly known)]

[Area: 3 kilometers in radius]

[Population: 260]

[Public support: 93 (average)]

[Buildings: 1. Secondary village administrative center, 2. Blacksmith shop, 3. Tailor shop, 4. Carpentry workshop...]

[Military: Golden Fire Cavalry, Militia Squad. ]

...

[Upgrade conditions: To upgrade to a third-level village, you need a population of 800, a public support of 80, and a third-level energy converter. 】

The territory expanded by one kilometer, and other changes were not significant.

Wang Shuo did not pay much attention to it, but immediately returned to the basic barracks.

He thought about it and decided to upgrade the cavalry barracks first.

At present, his ace unit is the golden fire cavalry. First, the number of this unit will be gathered to 100.

[Energy crystal - 10,000. 】

After selecting the cavalry barracks on the operation interface, the barracks immediately underwent a huge change.

First of all, the area of the barracks has expanded several times, directly occupying one-eighth of the territory area within the entire city wall.

It has spread from the edge of the city wall to the core building area.

Among them, stables and huge horse farms for cavalry training are automatically generated.
